 Audience Intelligence Tools 
 
 
 Your contact list holds more than email addresses. It contains the insights you need to understand your audience and reach them with the right message.
With Campaigner’s Audience Insights and AI Insight Builder, you can leverage enriched demographic intelligence to uncover meaningful patterns and instantly transform them into targeted segments.

— eCommerce Integrations
 
 
 
 
 
Turn Store Activity into Revenue with our New WooCommerce & BigCommerce Integrations
 
 
 
 
 
These free plugins connect your store directly to your Campaigner account, making it easy to trigger timely emails, sync shopper data, and turn everyday store activity into revenue generating campaigns.
The new Campaigner ecommerce integrations are designed to help marketers move faster without adding complexity. Once installed, your store events flow directly into Campaigner, where you can power automation, personalization, and segmentation using tools you already know.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Learn more about eComm Integrations
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
— automation workflows
 
 
 
 
 
Craft relevant, engaging customer journeys with our automation workflow builder.
 
 
 
 
 
Build simple or advanced automation workflows with our intuitive visual builder. Engage and nurture customers with highly relevant messaging using email, or email + SMS.
However you define a successful conversion, Campaigner’s workflows are an essential tool in nurturing subscribers and customers through your marketing and sales funnel. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore automation
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Up to 6x more conversions​
 
 
Campaigner customers typically see up to six times more conversion and sales when they use our multi-channel automation workflows compared to generic email drip campaigns.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 — Visual Builder 
 
 
 Effortlessly select your triggers and simply drag them into place. The entire customer journey appears in a clear, easy-to-understand UI. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 — Multi-channel Support 
 
 
 If you're a Campaigner SMS customer, you can create workflows that incorporate SMS triggers into your customer journey. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 — Validation Checks 
 
 
 Our validation tool will quickly check your newly built workflow for errors prior to activation.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Elevate your marketing campaigns with SMS. 
 
 
 
Not your typical SMS blast solution. 
Not using SMS for marketing? You're missing out on a 98% read rate! Send standalone SMS campaigns, or supercharge your email automation workflows by incorporating SMS triggers. 
 
 
 
 Explore campaigner sms 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
More Than a Platform: A Growth Ecosystem
 
 
 
 
 
Most email platforms are built for launch, not scale. As your list grows, a “complexity gap” emerges where data quality slips, bounce rates rise, and infrastructure limits throttle your revenue.
At this stage, simple execution isn’t enough. You need infrastructure, intelligence, and protection.
 
 
 
 
 
 That is where Campaigner stands apart. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
As part of the Ziff Davis Martech division, Campaigner is the orchestration layer within a specialized ecosystem of industry-leading brands. Instead of relying on disconnected third-party tools, you gain access to a unified framework designed to support email programs at every stage of growth.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Learn More
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Protect your sender reputation with Campaigner's Reputation Defender. 
 
 
 Maintain list health and prevent unwanted hard bounces with Reputation Defender, Campaigner's list verification tool.
 
A healthy list is an essential step towards maintaining your sender reputation. Reputation Defender periodically scans the email addresses in your contact list and returns a rating, giving you visibility into any potential delivery issues. It's added peace of mind for any email marketer! 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore Reputation Defender

Connect, engage and convert with Campaigner's personalization capabilities.
 
 
 
 
 
Create 1:1 email conversations with our personalization options. Whether it’s geolocation, purchase history, past engagement, or your own custom data, personalization is a surefire way to enhance your campaign performance.

ALL FEATURES
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Advanced email marketing features 
 
 
 Campaigner provides all the advanced email marketing features you need to execute engaging and high-performing marketing campaigns. 
 
 
 
 Start for free 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Email Marketing Automation
 
 
 
 
 Campaigner offers a number of automation features to ensure you never miss the opportunity to engage your audience at key moments in their journey. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Workflows
Nurture leads, foster repeat buyers and turn customers into brand advocates with event and trigger based marketing automation.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Recurring campaigns
Create and schedule recurring campaigns for common touchpoints with your audience.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
SMS Marketing
Create and send SMS messages directly from Campaigner; either as a standalone campaign or as part of an email workflow.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Autoresponders
Automatically send an email as a response to a customer action like a newsletter signup or preferences update.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Personalization 
 
 
 
 
 Personalized emails enhance the customer experience and deliver better engagement. Campaigner offers all the personalization features you need to get your emails noticed. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Segmentation
Create segments for targeted email campaigns based on contact activity, campaign engagement, demographic data, past purchase behavior and more.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Content Blocks 
articles
Create and reuse content sections across campaigns and sub-accounts. Reduce email design time and keep your emails on-brand.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Geolocation
Dynamically or conditionally customize content according to individual subscriber's location.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Dynamic content
Include dynamic content blocks in your email to deliver personalized and relevant content at time of email open based on a contact's individual preferences.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Conditional Content
Switch messaging, call to action and design based on conditional checks on contact data such as past conversions or custom fields.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Experiments
 
 
 
 
 Testing the components of an email campaign is a best practice for optimizing the results of your emails campaigns. Campaigner takes testing beyond the basic A/B option to also offer multivariate testing. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
subject line testing
Test subject lines to see which one delivers the highest open rates.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
from name testing
Use different From names (team members for example), to see which sender(s) your subscribers connect best with.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Send Time Testing
Test different send times for your email campaigns to see how it affects open and click rates.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Multivariate TESTING
Go beyond A/B testing and test multiple variants at the same time.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Content & Design Testing
Test the effectiveness of your content, images and/or email design to see which resonates best.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Ecommerce
 
 
 
 
 Connect your online store to Campaigner to create personalized email campaigns based on customer purchase history and product information. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Purchase Behaviour 
Use historical transaction and purchase behavior data to send customized emails to your customers.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Abandoned Cart Emails
Automatically trigger an email campaign after someone abandons their shopping cart during the purchase process.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Email Design
 
 
 
 
 Campaigner makes it easy to create highly engaging email campaigns that look great on all popular devices. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Drag & Drop Editor
Create beautiful email campaigns from scratch or using our pre-built templates. No coding skills required!
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Responsive Design
All Campaigner templates are built to be fully responsive for rendering on all popular devices.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Full email editor
Our HTML editor for those who prefer to build their campaigns using code, either within the editor or by importing HTML from elsewhere.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Template Management
Advanced template management system with folder structure, restricted access and tagging features to organize any number of templates. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Media Library
Store your images and PDF files for use in your email campaigns. Create nested folders to help you stay organized.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Image Editor
Edit images as needed without having to exit the email creation process.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Reporting
 
 
 
 
 Campaigner offers easy-to-understand reports to quickly see how your audience is engaging with your email campaigns. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Audience Insights
Understand Your Audience at a Glance with a visual dashboard that reveals key characteristics of your contacts. Instead of digging through raw data, you can explore your audience using clear, interactive charts.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Conversion tracking
Set up conversion tracking on email campaign links and assign a value to understand the revenue associated with your email campaigns.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Workflow reports
Examine each step of your automation workflows. See how many contacts are at each stage of your workflow and how many have converted, exited and are being nurtured. 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
autoresponder reports
Identify how and when your autoresponders are firing and how they are performing in terms of delivery, open and click rates and conversions.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Experiment Reports
Get in-depth reports on your split testing experiments; right from email content to link clicks, open and click rates, conversions and subscriber activity.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Email campaign reports
Review opens, clicks, heat maps and other engagement data that reflects the performance of your campaigns.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
geolocation reports
See how your campaigns are behaving by location. Get zip code level data on delivery, open rates, clicks and conversions. 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
User Agent Reports
See opens and clicks by operating system, browser and email client.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Subscriber Growth
 
 
 
 
 Subscriber growth is key to a healthy email list. Campaigner makes it easy to capture and manage subscribers. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Signup Forms
Create and customize sign-up forms to capture emails on your website and landing pages.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Preference Management
Allow subscribers to easily update their communication preferences or simply unsubscribe from all communications. 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Landing Pages
Design and customize responsive landing pages to host sign-up forms and other relevant content or offers. 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
social sharing
Automatically share your email content as social media posts for added reach. 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Contact Management
 
 
 
 
 Contact data is your most valuable asset, and Campaigner allows you to and leverage the information that matters most for your email campaigns. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI Insight Builder
Describe the audience you want to reach using simple, natural language, and instantly generate precise mailing lists. No manual filtering. No guesswork. Just targeted segments you can use right away to launch more relevant campaigns.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Computed Fields
Make rule-based custom fields for your contacts that update data based on computation logic.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Custom Fields
Add and populate custom fields to your contacts using file uploads or automatic syncs from native and third-party integrations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Suppression Lists
Maintain global suppression lists without deleting contacts and keep your subscriber lists healthy and your delivery optimal.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Exclusion Lists
Create lists that are excluded from campaigns and workflows based on pre-defined rules.
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Categories
Create categories to organize your contacts and segments based on your own custom-defined rules and conditional logic.
LEARN MORE
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
For Developers
 
 
 
 
 For those who handle some or all of their email marketing programmatically, Campaigner has you covered. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Campaigner API
Populate contacts, trigger emails or build your own custom integrations with out powerful API.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
SMTP Relay
Send transactional emails by connecting your apps using our SMTP relay API.
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
sFTP
Import or export contact data using Secure File Transfer Protocol (sFTP).
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Ready to get started with Campaigner? 
 
 
 Get a free demo and custom quote for your business.​ 
 
 
 
 get free demo

Essentials

Custom
 
 
 
 
 
HTML Editor
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Build your campaigns using HTML code, either within the editor or by importing HTML 
 
 
Drag & Drop Editor
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Design and customize emails with ease. No coding required. 
 
 
AI: Subject Line Generator
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Generate engaging subject lines for your email campaigns using AI 
 
 
Campaigns: One-Time, Scheduled, & Recurring
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Send one-time campaigns, schedule them for a specific date & time, or set up recurring campaigns (e.g. weekly on Tuesday) 
 
 
Experiments (A/B testing)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Test different subject lines, content, and other aspects of a campaign to find the best performing version 
 
 
Experiments (Multivariate Testing)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Go beyond A/B testing to test multiple variants at the same time 
 
 
Custom From and Reply-To Addresses
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Use different From names (e.g. team members), to see which sender(s) your subscribers respond best to 
 
 
Dynamic Content
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Deliver personalized, relevant content at time of email open to each contact on your list 
 
 
Merge Fields
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Personalize emails using merge fields to include items like first name and other relevant contact attributes 
 
 
Content Blocks
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create and reuse blocks of content for future campaigns 
 
 
Conditional Content
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Switch messaging, call to action or design based on conditional checks on contact data such as past conversions. 
 
 
RSS Feeds
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Include content from RSS feeds by uploading an HTML file or fetching content from a URL 
 
 
Pre-built Templates
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Choose one of our ready-made templates to help get your email campaign started 
 
 
Mobile-Responsive Templates
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Templates that automatically render well for desktop, mobile, or tablet 
 
 
Create content from an HTML File
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Import HTML into your template to introduce custom design elements or custom-formatted content. 
 
 
Create content from a URL
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Pull external content (e.g a news article) into the body of your email using a URL 
 
 
Plain Text Version
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Choose to make a plain text version of your email campaign available 
 
 
Social Sharing
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Automatically share your email content as social media posts for added reach 
 
 
Preview and Test Sending
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Send your email campaign to one or more contacts as a test to see how the design and content render 
 
 
Remove Campaigner Branding
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Removes the "Sent by Campaigner" branding from the footer of your email campaigns 
 
 
Include Tracked Links
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Use Campaigner's link tracking to track conversions from email campaigns links or CTAs 
 
 
Include Google Analytics Links
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Use Google Analytics links to track conversions from email campaign links or CTAs 
 
 
Include Adobe Analytics Links
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Use Adobe Analytics links to track conversions from email campaign links or CTAs 
 
 
Custom URL Parameters
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create custom URL parameters for each link/CTA in an email 
 
 
Edit Tracked Links (Email) Post-send
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Modify links in an email by specifying a different link destination 
 
 
Autoreplies (Email)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Set up an automatic reply to send to someone if they reply to your email campaign (eg. Unmontiored mailbox) 
 
 
Media Library Storage
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Store up to 50MB of images and other media for use in your email campaigns 
 
 
Transactional Email (SMTP Relay)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Send transactional email messages (eg shipping confirmations) to your recipients

 Automatically send an email to have someone confirm their email address 
 
 
Autoresponders: Recurring
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Set up an automatic, recurring email to go to one or more contacts (e.g. birthday email) 
 
 
Simple and Advanced Workflows
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create simple, straight-line or complex workflows with multiple paths 
 
 
Time-based Triggers
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Schedule messages to send at the optimal time for engagement 
 
 
Rules-based Triggers
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Send messages based on a defined action, form submission, or other action from a contact 
 
 
Conditional Triggers
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Define the next step for a contact in a workflow based on a defined action or non-action 
 
 
Custom Triggers
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Define a step in the workflow based on custom parameters 
 
 
Delay Nodes
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Define the timeframe before the workflow continues to the next step 
 
 
Auto-update Contact Fields
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Define the custom contact fields or list memberships to change for a contact in a workflow 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Segmentation
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Essentials
Advanced
Custom
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Essentials
Advanced
Custom
 
 
 
 
 
Static Segments
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create a non-editable snapshot of contacts who match specific criteria when creating the segment 
 
 
Dynamic Segments
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create an editable snapshot of contacts who match specific criteria when an email campaign is sent. New contacts meeting the criteria will be added to the segment. 
 
 
Simple and Advanced Segments
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create segments with one or more conditions/critera using our segment builder 
 
 
Segment by Email Delivery & Activity
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create segments based on campaign activity (eg. All openers of a campaign) 
 
 
Segment by Form Submissions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create a segment based on a specific subscription form 
 
 
Assign List Membership
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Assign contacts to be members of one or more mailing lists 
 
 
Segment by Contact Fields
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create segments based on specific contact fields within Campaigner 
 
 
Filter Grouping
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create a segment to filter contacts based on criteria you specify (eg. Birth month) 
 
 
Segment by Specific Workflow
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create a segment based on contacts who were part of a specific workflow 
 
 
Geolocation Segments (IP, Region, Timezone)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create segments based on geographic location, IP range, or time zone 
 
 
Segment by SMTP Relay Activity
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create segments based on opens, clicks in transactional messages

Custom Fields - Text
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create a custom field with text-based information (e.g. City) 
 
 
Custom Fields - Number
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create a custom field with number-based information (e.g. phone number) 
 
 
Custom Fields - Calendar
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create a custom field with date-based information (e.g. birthday) 
 
 
Custom Fields - Single & Multi-Select
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Select one or more custom fields to filter contacts by for the purpose of creating a segment or mailing list 
 
 
Custom Fields - Boolean
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create a custom field with computed or binary values (e.g. true/false) 
 
 
Clean Contacts
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Quickly delete inactive (unsubscribed, hard bounced, and older pending) contacts from your contact list 
 
 
Test Contacts
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Define a list of contacts to receive test sends of your campaign 
 
 
Custom Unique Identifier
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Specify a field other than email address to be the unique identifier for your Campaigner account (e.g phone number) 
 
 
Send on Behalf Of
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Specify a brand or company as the owner of an email campaign if different from the sender/sending domain
